headlines.title: 央行陆磊：中国没有必要也无意通过汇率贬值来获取贸易竞争优势
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，中国没有必要也无意通过汇率贬值来获取贸易竞争优势。随着出口结构转型升级，企业的议价能力和汇率风险管理能力不断增强，中国贸易对汇率的敏感性大幅度下降，同时外贸企业也更多使用汇率避险工具，人民币在贸易结算中的占比不断提升，也进一步降低了贸易对汇率的敏感性。（新华财经）

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: China has no need and no intention to gain trade competitive advantage through currency depreciation
headlines.summary_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei stated that China has no need and no intention to gain trade competitive advantages through currency depreciation. As the export structure transforms and upgrades, enterprises' bargaining power and exchange rate risk management capabilities have continuously strengthened, and the sensitivity of China's trade to exchange rates has significantly declined. Meanwhile, foreign trade enterprises are increasingly using exchange rate hedging tools, and the rising share of the RMB in trade settlement has further reduced trade sensitivity to exchange rates. (Xinhua Finance)

headlines.title: 央行：提升货币政策的沟通和预期管理水平
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊9月10日在国新办“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上表示，为实施好“十五五”规划纲要和金融强国建设“十五五”规划。近日制定印发了《中国人民银行“十五五”改革发展规划》，配套出台了9份相关领域行动方案。他进一步表示，要构建科学稳健的货币政策体系和覆盖全面的宏观审慎管理体系，做好逆周期和跨周期调节，保持好社会融资规模、货币供应量增长同经济增长和价格总水平预期目标相匹配。“为此，要健全市场化利率形成、调控和传导机制，发挥市场在汇率形成中的决定性作用，增强人民币汇率弹性，保持人民币汇率在合理均衡水平上的基本稳定。”他说。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Enhance monetary policy communication and expectation management
headlines.summary_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei stated on September 10 at the State Council Information Office's "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" themed press conference that, in order to implement the 15th Five-Year Plan outline and the 15th Five-Year Plan for building a financial powerhouse, the PBOC recently formulated and issued the "PBOC 15th Five-Year Plan Reform and Development Plan," along with nine supporting action plans in related fields. He further stated that it is necessary to build a scientific and robust monetary policy system and a comprehensive macroprudential management system, conduct countercyclical and cross-cyclical adjustments, and keep the growth of aggregate social financing and money supply aligned with economic growth and the expected target for the overall price level. "To this end, it is necessary to improve the market-based interest rate formation, regulation, and transmission mechanism, give play to the decisive role of the market in exchange rate formation, enhance the flexibility of the RMB exchange rate, and keep the RMB exchange rate basically stable at a reasonable and balanced level," he said.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：央行将坚定保持货币币值稳定 更加注重发挥利率型调控工具的作用
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，人民银行将进一步完善优化中国特色现代货币政策框架体系。人民银行将坚定保持货币币值稳定，并以此促进经济增长，有效支持实体经济高质量发展。同时，逐步淡化数量型中介目标，更加注重发挥利率型调控工具的作用。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: The PBOC will firmly maintain currency value stability and place greater emphasis on the role of interest-rate-based regulatory tools
headlines.summary_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei stated that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the PBOC will further improve and optimize the modern monetary policy framework system with Chinese characteristics. The PBOC will firmly maintain currency value stability and thereby promote economic growth and effectively support the high-quality development of the real economy. At the same time, it will gradually dilute quantity-based intermediate targets and place greater emphasis on the role of interest rate-based regulatory tools. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 证监会李超：加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，对于“十五五”时期资本市场工作，证监会将围绕“打造安全、规范、透明、开放、有活力、有韧性的资本市场”这一总目标，以持续深化投融资综合改革为牵引，以提高制度包容性、适应性为导向，以依法从严加强监管为保障，加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放，力争到2030年资本市场建立四十周年之际，资本市场高质量发展的新格局基本形成，综合实力与国际竞争力大幅增强。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Accelerate the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated that for capital market work during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the CSRC will focus on the overall goal of "building a safe, standardized, transparent, open, vibrant, and resilient capital market," take the continuous deepening of comprehensive investment and financing reform as the driving force, be guided by improving institutional inclusiveness and adaptability, and take strict regulation in accordance with the law as the guarantee, to accelerate the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up, striving to basically form a new pattern of high-quality capital market development by 2030, the 40th anniversary of the establishment of the capital market, with comprehensive strength and international competitiveness greatly enhanced. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：“十五五”时期将发展人民币离岸市场，丰富离岸人民币流动性供给
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，将着力以开放促改革发展，推进金融高水平对外开放。为此我们推进人民币国际化，加强金融基础设施跨境互联互通，发展人民币离岸市场，丰富离岸人民币流动性供给。

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the offshore RMB market will be developed and the supply of offshore RMB liquidity will be enriched
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei stated that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, efforts will be made to promote reform and development through opening up and advance high-level financial opening up. To this end, the PBOC will promote RMB internationalization, strengthen cross-border interconnection of financial infrastructure, develop the offshore RMB market, and enrich offshore RMB liquidity supply.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：促进人工智能在资本市场规范应用
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，下一步证监会将着力提高资本市场监管和治理水平，不断完善准入、持续监管、退市和交易、机构等全链条监管体系，加快构建行政刑事民事有效衔接的追责体系。促进人工智能在资本市场规范应用，推进监管数智化转型，加强新型业务监管和风险管控。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Promote the standardized application of artificial intelligence in the capital market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated that next the CSRC will focus on improving the level of capital market regulation and governance, continuously improving the full-chain regulatory system covering access, ongoing supervision, delisting, trading, and institutions, and accelerating the construction of an accountability system that effectively connects administrative, criminal, and civil proceedings. It will promote the standardized application of artificial intelligence in the capital market, advance the digital and intelligent transformation of regulation, and strengthen regulation and risk control of new types of business.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：推动中长期资金稳步提升入市规模和比例
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，下一步，证监会将持续健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态，推动中长期资金稳步提升入市规模和比例，大力发展权益类公募基金，强化各类中长期资金“稳定器”功能。强化跨市场跨行业跨境风险监测，推动健全支持资本市场货币政策工具长效机制，丰富政策工具箱。加强和改进资本市场预期管理，积极营造良好舆论生态。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Promote a steady increase in the scale and proportion of medium- and long-term funds entering the market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated that next the CSRC will continue to improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money for long-term investment," promote the steady increase in the scale and proportion of medium- and long-term capital entering the market, vigorously develop equity public funds, and strengthen the "stabilizer" function of various types of medium- and long-term capital. It will strengthen cross-market, cross-industry, and cross-border risk monitoring, promote the establishment of a long-term mechanism for monetary policy tools supporting the capital market, and enrich the policy toolbox. It will strengthen and improve capital market expectation management and actively foster a sound public opinion environment.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：持续加强稳市场机制建设 全力维护资本市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性。总结过去几年经验做法，持续加强稳市场机制建设，不断壮大市场稳定力量。进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态。强化风险监测预警和综合研判应对，全力维护资本市场平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Continuously strengthen the building of market stabilization mechanisms and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated that the endogenous stability of the capital market will be further enhanced. Summarizing the experience and practices of the past few years, the CSRC will continue to strengthen the construction of market stabilization mechanisms and continuously expand the forces for market stability. It will further broaden the sources, channels, and market-entry methods of medium- and long-term capital, and improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money for long-term investment." It will strengthen risk monitoring, early warning, and comprehensive analysis and response, and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market.

headlines.title: 证监会明确“十五五”资本市场发展目标，加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放
headlines.summary: 中国证监会副主席李超9月10日在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上说，加快推进实施新一轮资本市场改革开放，力争到2030年资本市场建立四十周年之际，基本形成资本市场高质量发展新格局，综合实力与国际竞争力明显提高。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: CSRC clarifies the capital market development goals for the 15th Five-Year Plan, accelerating the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated on September 10 at the State Council Information Office's "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" themed press conference that the CSRC will accelerate the implementation of a new round of capital market reform and opening up, striving to basically form a new pattern of high-quality capital market development by 2030, the 40th anniversary of the establishment of the capital market, with comprehensive strength and international competitiveness significantly improved. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：今年以来沪深两市IPO平均审核周期缩短至6个多月
headlines.summary: 在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上，中国证监会副主席李超表示，证监会将更大力度激发市场活力。支持新质生产力优质企业发展壮大，是新征程上资本市场的时代使命。近年来，证监会推出深化科创板、创业板等改革，进一步提升再融资灵活性便利性，改革成效逐步显现。今年以来，沪深两市IPO平均审核周期缩短至6个多月，一些优质公司再融资审核不到1个月。（21财经）

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Since the beginning of this year, the average IPO review cycle for the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges has shortened to more than 6 months
headlines.summary_en: At the State Council Information Office's "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" themed press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated that the CSRC will make greater efforts to stimulate market vitality. Supporting the development and growth of high-quality enterprises representing new quality productive forces is the era mission of the capital market on the new journey. In recent years, the CSRC has launched reforms to deepen the STAR Market and ChiNext, further enhancing the flexibility and convenience of refinancing, with reform results gradually emerging. Since the beginning of this year, the average review period for IPOs on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges has shortened to more than six months, and some high-quality companies have received refinancing approval in less than one month. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 证监会李超：“十五五”资本市场重点做好八个“进一步”
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，“十五五”资本市场重点要做好八个方面工作，一是进一步提高资本市场制度包容性、适应性；二是进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性；三是进一步加强监管和投资者保护；四是进一步健全多层次资本市场体系；五是进一步提高上市公司质量和投资价值；六是进一步加快建设一流投资银行和投资机构；七是进一步建设安全高效的金融基础设施；八是进一步扩大高水平对外开放。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: The capital market during the 15th Five-Year Plan period will focus on doing well in eight 'further' areas
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the capital market will focus on eight areas of work: first, further improving the inclusiveness and adaptability of the capital market system; second, further enhancing the endogenous stability of the capital market; third, further strengthening regulation and investor protection; fourth, further improving the multi-tiered capital market system; fifth, further improving the quality and investment value of listed companies; sixth, further accelerating the construction of first-class investment banks and investment institutions; seventh, further building safe and efficient financial infrastructure; and eighth, further expanding high-level opening up.

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：修订后的证券公司监管条例有望于近期出台
headlines.summary: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，更大力度加强法治保障。我们将坚持在市场化、法治化轨道上推进改革发展，发挥好法治固根本、稳预期、利长远的重要作用，进一步健全资本市场法律制度体系。修订后的证券公司监管条例有望于近期出台。我们还将抓紧推动证券投资基金法、上市公司监管条例等重要法律法规的制定修改。同时，进一步完善符合我国国情市情的投资者保护体系，积极营造公开公正的市场环境。

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: The revised Securities Company Supervision Regulations are expected to be issued in the near future
headlines.summary_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated on the afternoon of September 10 at a State Council Information Office press conference that legal safeguards will be strengthened with greater efforts. The CSRC will adhere to promoting reform and development on the track of marketization and the rule of law, give full play to the important role of the rule of law in consolidating foundations, stabilizing expectations, and benefiting the long term, and further improve the capital market legal system. The revised Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Securities Companies are expected to be issued in the near future. The CSRC will also expedite the formulation and amendment of important laws and regulations such as the Securities Investment Fund Law and the Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Listed Companies. At the same time, it will further improve the investor protection system suited to China's national conditions and market conditions, and actively foster an open and fair market environment.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：“十五五”时期将完善金融统计、支付、国库、现金服务体系
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，“十五五”时期，人民银行将全面夯实央行履职基础，持续优化金融基础设施和中央银行服务体系，提升中央银行金融服务质效，完善金融统计、支付、国库、现金服务体系。

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the financial statistics, payment, treasury and cash service systems will be improved
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei stated that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the PBOC will comprehensively consolidate the foundation for the central bank to perform its duties, continuously optimize financial infrastructure and the central bank service system, improve the quality and efficiency of central bank financial services, and improve the financial statistics, payment, treasury, and cash service systems.

headlines.title: 央行陆磊：到2035年，基本建成具有高度适应性、竞争力、普惠性的中国特色现代金融体系
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》正式出台。《规划》的整体规划是：到2030年，金融调控政策协同有效，金融风险防控精准高效，金融业的国际影响力和竞争力持续提高。到2035年，基本建成具有高度适应性、竞争力、普惠性的中国特色现代金融体系。

headlines.title_en: PBOC's Lu Lei: By 2035, a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics that is highly adaptive, competitive, and inclusive will be basically established
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, Lu Lei, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, stated that the "15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Power" was officially issued. The overall plan of the "Plan" is: by 2030, financial regulation policies will be coordinated and effective, financial risk prevention and control will be precise and efficient, and the international influence and competitiveness of the financial industry will continue to improve. By 2035, a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics that is highly adaptive, competitive, and inclusive will be basically established.

headlines.title: 证监会：全力维护资本市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊表示，中国没有必要也无意通过汇率贬值来获取贸易竞争优势。随着出口结构转型升级，企业的议价能力和汇率风险管理能力不断增强，中国贸易对汇率的敏感性大幅度下降，同时外贸企业也更多使用汇率避险工具，人民币在贸易结算中的占比不断提升，也进一步降低了贸易对汇率的敏感性。（新华财经）

headlines.title: 证监会李超：加强新型业务监管和风险管控
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月10日讯，9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，下一步证监会将着力提高资本市场监管和治理水平，不断完善准入、持续监管、退市和交易、机构等全链条监管体系，加快构建行政刑事民事有效衔接的追责体系。促进人工智能在资本市场规范应用，推进监管数智化转型，加强新型业务监管和风险管控。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Strengthen regulation of new types of business and risk control
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 10 — On September 10, at a State Council Information Office press conference, CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao stated that next the CSRC will focus on improving the level of capital market regulation and governance, continuously improving the full-chain regulatory system covering access, ongoing supervision, delisting, trading, and institutions, and accelerating the construction of an accountability system that effectively connects administrative, criminal, and civil proceedings. It will promote the standardized application of artificial intelligence in the capital market, advance the digital and intelligent transformation of regulation, and strengthen regulation and risk control of new types of business.

headlines.title: 证监会副主席李超：进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式 全力维护资本市场平稳运行
headlines.summary: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，进一步增强资本市场内在稳定性。总结过去几年经验做法，持续加强稳市机制建设，不断壮大市场稳定力量。进一步拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，健全“长钱长投”的市场机制和生态。强化风险监测预警和综合研判应对，全力维护资本市场平稳运行。（21财经）

headlines.title_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao: Further broaden medium- and long-term funding sources, channels, and ways of entering the market, and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market
headlines.summary_en: Li Chao, Vice Chairman of the CSRC, said on the afternoon of the 10th at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that the intrinsic stability of the capital market will be further enhanced. Summarize the experience and practices of the past few years, continue to strengthen the construction of market stabilization mechanisms, and continuously expand the forces for market stability. Further broaden the sources of medium- and long-term funds, channels, and ways of entering the market, and improve the market mechanism and ecosystem for "long-term money for long-term investment." Strengthen risk monitoring, early warning, and comprehensive analysis and response, and make every effort to maintain the smooth operation of the capital market. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 证监会李超：资本市场正在发生日益深刻的结构性变化
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，近年来，证监会贯彻落实新“国九条”确定的各项任务，以“两创板”改革为突破口，进一步增强制度包容性、适应性，大力推动中长期资金入市，持续深化资本市场投融资综合改革。资本市场正在发生日益深刻的结构性变化，投融资协调发展态势加快形成，服务实体经济质效不断提升。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: The capital market is undergoing increasingly profound structural changes
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, Li Chao, Vice Chairman of the CSRC, stated that in recent years, the CSRC has implemented the tasks set by the new "State Council Nine-Point Guideline," taking the reform of the "two innovation boards" as a breakthrough point, further enhancing institutional inclusiveness and adaptability, vigorously promoting the entry of medium- and long-term funds into the market, and continuously deepening the comprehensive reform of capital market investment and financing. Profound structural changes are taking place in the capital market, the trend of coordinated development of investment and financing is accelerating, and the quality and efficiency of serving the real economy are constantly improving.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：提高监管执法威慑力 完善投资者保护制度机制
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，进一步加强监管和投资者保护。坚守金融工作的人民性，持续强化“五大监管”，聚焦欺诈发行、财务造假、操纵市场、内幕交易等重大违法行为，在“打准、打疼”上下功夫，提高监管执法威慑力。加快推动健全资本市场法律制度体系，完善投资者保护制度机制，让投资者切实感受到市场的公平正义。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Enhance the deterrence of regulatory enforcement and improve the systems and mechanisms for investor protection
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, Li Chao, Vice Chairman of the CSRC, stated that regulation and investor protection will be further strengthened. Adhere to the people-oriented nature of financial work, continue to strengthen the "five major regulators," focus on major illegal acts such as fraudulent issuance, financial fraud, market manipulation, and insider trading, and work hard to "target accurately and hit hard" to improve the deterrent effect of regulatory enforcement. Accelerate the improvement of the legal system of the capital market and improve the institutional mechanisms for investor protection, so that investors can truly feel the fairness and justice of the market.

headlines.title: 证监会李超：优化发行上市制度 支持新兴产业等优质企业发展壮大
headlines.summary: 9月10日，在国新办新闻发布会上，证监会副主席李超表示，进一步提高资本市场制度包容性、适应性。主动适应全球科技创新与产业变革新趋势，持续加力做好科技金融等“五篇大文章”，大力提升资本市场服务新质生产力发展质效。优化发行上市制度，支持新兴产业、未来产业、传统产业转型升级和现代服务业、新型消费等不同类型、不同行业、多元化的优质企业发展壮大。

headlines.title_en: CSRC's Li Chao: Optimize the issuance and listing system to support the development and growth of high-quality enterprises such as those in emerging industries
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office, Li Chao, Vice Chairman of the CSRC, stated that the institutional inclusiveness and adaptability of the capital market will be further improved. Actively adapt to the new trends of global technological innovation and industrial transformation, continue to intensify efforts in the "five major articles" including technology finance, and vigorously improve the quality and efficiency of the capital market in serving the development of new quality productive forces. Optimize the issuance and listing system, and support the development and growth of high-quality enterprises of different types, industries, and diversity, including emerging industries, future industries, the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, modern service industries, and new types of consumption.

headlines.title: 《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》正式出台
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行副行长陆磊9月10日在国新办举行的“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会上表示，近日，《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》正式出台。为实施好相关部署，中国人民银行制定印发了《中国人民银行“十五五”改革发展规划》，配套出台了9份相关领域的行动方案。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: The "15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Powerhouse" was officially issued
headlines.summary_en: Lu Lei, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, said on September 10 at the series of themed press conferences on "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" held by the State Council Information Office that recently, the "15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Power" was officially issued. In order to implement the relevant arrangements, the People's Bank of China formulated and issued the "People's Bank of China 15th Five-Year Reform and Development Plan," and supporting nine action plans in related fields. (Xinhua News Agency)
